text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian has claimed a magnificent 
victory in the "Arima Kinen".

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A frustrated Hishi Amazon vowed to get her 
revenge. Narita Brian looked forward to 
racing her undaunted rival once more.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Over the past year, she had met countless 
formidable rivals. Battling them had 
brought Narita Brian a deep sense of 
fulfillment...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Next year is finally the Senior Class. The 
next goal is the Hanshin Daishoten—!
